en: Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default
zh: 变更桌面应用和 VS Code 的行为：与终端一致，主对话的 subagent 始终在后台运行，而不再由 Claude 选择；在 `claude -p`、Agent SDK、桌面应用和 VS Code 中，subagent 自身发起的 Agent 调用现在默认在前台运行
